scenes.title: The truth nobody can hear
scenes.viewerPurpose: Being right does not ensure that a truth can be faced. Defines a civilized mind by truthful self-correction with dignity, while preserving limits where abuse and unequal power constrain conversation.

cues.text: You can be right about a problem and make it harder for anyone to face it.

cues.text: The Civilized Mind argues that facing the truth also requires the skill to correct ourselves without cruelty.
